rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Dead-end turning head backing onto bush, but apartments sit about 10 m away.
reasons: Backs onto dense bush on the west
Apartments 10 m, more homes within 18 m
Only 8 m long, in the turning area

drivers.seclusion: Bush and tree canopy to the north and west; Blenheim apartments 10 m and others 16-18 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed dead end with a wide turning head; room to stand clear but it is also where drivers turn.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end residential street; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: A car parks at the kerb nearby; sign bans parking weekdays 8am-4pm only.

flags: Homes within about 25 m all round
Short section, about one van length
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from the north and west; open to the south-east.
cannot_judge: Whether the turning head is kept clear

best_section.where: West edge of the Queens Road dead-end turning head, against the bush
